title: Button Styles
description: Restyle every Primary, Secondary and Tertiary button: size, corners and hover effects, set in a configurator. Colors and fonts stay with Site Styles.

options.name: data-sp-style
options.on: a Squarespace button (set by the button-icons script)
options.description: "plain" leaves that one button unstyled. Set it with the button-icons script, e.g. data-sp-buttons="Get started: plain".
